market_summary: USD and safe-haven flows dominate during the London/NY overlap. Gold and Bitcoin are in strong cascading downward trends trading far below their session Value Areas and lower ATR bands, but are currently extended into major session support levels and GEX Put Walls. US100 saw a climactic RVOL spike rejection off the session high back toward VWAP within a positive GEX regime. EURUSD is consolidating on lower ATR support. All setups currently show exhaustion or test key boundary zones, warranting patience and a full HOLD stance across the board.

signals.rationale: 1) VP context: Price is trading at 3869.18, well below VAL (3938.58) and below POC (3977.51), confirming extreme trend expansion into low-volume territory. 2) CVD: CVD is -9.83 with label BEARISH and negative slope (-1.31), agreeing with short momentum. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP provides high-liquidity execution. 4) Trend: Steep downtrend with price heavily rejected below both VWAP (3952.84) and EMA50 (3943.27). 5) ATR: Deeply extended below the lower ATR band (3892.21), riding the band lower in an expansion phase. 6) Volume: Multiple yellow RVOL spikes (>2.0) on the preceding breakdown legs, though current RVOL is 1.539. 7) S/R & GEX: GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3925.95). Price has pierced Put Wall #1 (3875.62) and is breaking Session Low (3866.09), but selling directly into an extended stretched level against Put Wall #1 without a pullback carries high risk of mean reversion snapback. Prefer HOLD to avoid chasing at the lows.
